headline: Get your evenings back from the admin that eats your week
sub: I improve the systems behind small businesses so quotes, bookings and reporting run without you chasing them. You spend your time on the work, not the paperwork.

changes.title: Less admin, more of the work you enjoy

cards.title: Quotes that chase themselves
cards.text: Follow-ups on quotes are set up once, so you stop having to remember to send them.

cards.title: Bookings without the back and forth
cards.text: Confirmations and reminders go out on their own, so fewer messages land on your phone.

cards.title: Reports that appear
cards.text: The weekly numbers are pulled together for you, so your Friday evening is your own.

closing: Ready to get your evenings back?
